notes.title: Reverting update
notes.notes: I broke stuff, reverting the christmas update for now.. whoops

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where you could un-buy certain upgrades
 Fixed a bug where the metal detector reward from the lootbug replaced the existing metal detector buff instead of adding onto it

notes.title: More bug fixes
notes.notes:
For players that have a corrupted save, if you press 'W' 5 times on the resolution select launcher you will be given an option to wipe your file, allowing you to play again
 Fix for an exploit to be in any zone at any wave
 Fix for a rare edge case where you could get negative greenprints resulting in you not being able to craft anything

notes.title: Hotfix #2 - Window resize + misc
notes.notes:
Clarified you can adjust the window size at any time on start screen
 Fixed level up sounds still playing when toggled off
 Text fixes

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Fix for position of quick travel buttons
 Temporarily allowed for window resizing to accommodate for big boy monitors
